description: This Java class defines common configuration properties for protocol adapters in the Hono framework. It includes parameters like authentication requirements, vendor property inclusion, default value usage, timeout settings, and connection limits, indicating it's a configuration class within the core source code.

classes.name: ProtocolAdapterProperties
classes.description: A class representing configurable properties for protocol adapters in the Hono framework, extending ServiceConfigProperties, including settings for authentication, vendor properties, defaults, timeouts, and connection limits.

methods.name: isAuthenticationRequired
methods.description: Checks whether the protocol adapter requires device authentication based on provided credentials.

methods.name: setAuthenticationRequired
methods.description: Sets whether the protocol adapter should always authenticate devices using their credentials.

methods.name: isJmsVendorPropsEnabled
methods.description: Determines if vendor properties are included in downstream messages as per AMQP JMS mapping.

methods.name: setJmsVendorPropsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables inclusion of vendor properties in messages.

methods.name: isDefaultsEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if default device values are used to augment messages.

methods.name: setDefaultsEnabled
methods.description: Sets whether default device values should be used.

methods.name: getEventLoopBlockedCheckTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the timeout used to check if the event loop is blocked.

methods.name: setEventLoopBlockedCheckTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for checking if the event loop is blocked.

methods.name: getMaxConnections
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of concurrent connections allowed.

methods.name: setMaxConnections
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of concurrent connections. Throws if set to a negative value.

methods.name: isConnectionLimitConfigured
methods.description: Indicates whether a connection limit has been explicitly configured.

methods.name: getTenantIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration after which an idle tenant times out.

methods.name: setTenantIdleTimeout
methods.description: Sets the duration after which an idle tenant times out.
